sources.title: Planning application process
sources.verified_claim: Enfield describes validation, decision targets and June 2026 registration performance; a valid application or service target is not permission or candidate deliverability.

sources.title: How to make a planning application
sources.verified_claim: Applications must meet national and local validation requirements and pay the correct fee; incomplete submissions may be withdrawn as invalid. Requirements depend on actual proposal type.

sources.title: Planning application process
sources.verified_claim: Havering's process page links pre-application, application and local validation routes. Process guidance does not establish that parcel_46142 has or will obtain permission.

sources.title: Validation checklists
sources.verified_claim: Havering publishes application-type validation checklists and publication/privacy requirements. Checklist compliance is a submission gate, not an approval outcome.

sources.title: Submit or pay for a planning application
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth explains submission routes, fees and discharge-of-condition applications; invalid applications can attract administrative charges. Fees and submission routes do not imply permission.

sources.title: Apply for approval of details reserved by condition (discharge of conditions)
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's pilot supports applications to discharge or confirm compliance with planning conditions. A service being available is not evidence that a candidate has conditions or has discharged them.

sources.title: Validation of your application
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth checks whether sufficient information has been provided before treating an application as valid. Validation is an administrative threshold distinct from planning merits.

sources.title: Use of planning conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: National guidance requires planning conditions to meet six tests and distinguishes pre-commencement, discharge, deemed discharge and enforcement issues. Conditions are permission-specific and cannot be inferred from general guidance.
